page.description: Nobara 44 images: Official, GNOME and KDE, with sizes and publisher SHA-256 files.
page.intro: A Fedora-based desktop tuned for gaming, with codecs, drivers and patches applied by the project. Three images: Official, GNOME and KDE.
pros: Fedora base with gaming and multimedia patches pre-applied.
Official, GNOME and KDE images from one build.
The project publishes a per-image SHA-256 file.
Updates follow Fedora, with the project's own fixes.
cons: Fedora's short support window means upgrades every few months.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Nobara; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image per desktop, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. All three images are the 2026-10-13 build.
